sourceRef.section: Chapter 3.9 — Action Plan of Nationally Determined Contributions

adaptationGoals.description: Reduce impact and risk of climate change in the livestock sector, ensure sustainable development in the sectoral development and increase production

Establish a sustainable supply chain mechanism of healthy food products, livestock fodder and raw materials for light industry through leveraging positive impacts and mitigation of negative impacts of climate change in agricultural sector
Introducing optimal water consumption and build capacity to increase water reserves
Create forest ecosystems well adapted to climate change and enhance carbon sequestration by implementing sustainable forest management
Enable adaptation opportunities and adaptive capacities for vulnerable biodiversity to climate change
Build resilience to natural disasters by reducing the risks and adapting to impacts of climate and weather-related hazards and disasters

Strengthening healthcare services and capacities for early warning of potential health risks, and provision of proactive and response measures through the comprehensive study of climate impacts on public health

Establish a system providing social safeguard, insurance and prevention measures to reduce the vulnerability of social groups and build their resilience to climate change impacts by identifying groups vulnerable to climate change

actions.name: Improvement of water resources and fodder production by building irrigation systems and boreholes/groundwater wells
actions.description: Improved water sources and access
actions.outcome: Improved water sources and access
actions.indicator: Number of new irrigation systems installed and bore wells
actions.implementationStatus: Rehabilitation and construction of new irrigation systems are ongoing.
actions.objectives: Number of new irrigation systems installed and bore wells

actions.name: Conduct water resource assessment and survey to increase pastureland and its resources
actions.description: Increased pastureland (ha)
actions.outcome: Increased pastureland (ha)
actions.indicator: Number of water resource assessment reports
actions.implementationStatus: This is ongoing work, final result will be completed by end of 2024. IRIMHE, Institute of Geo-ecology are the key institutions to conduct the assessment.
actions.objectives: Number of water resource assessment reports

actions.name: Introduction of new technology and equipment for fodder preparation for production to ensure sustainable pastureland use
actions.description: Equipment for producing hay and fodder
actions.outcome: Equipment for producing hay and fodder
actions.indicator: Number of aimags with upgraded equipment for producing fodder
actions.implementationStatus: Ongoing. South-South exchanges are a key means to support and develop these efforts.
actions.objectives: Number of aimags with upgraded equipment for producing fodder

actions.name: Introduction of drip and permeable irrigation technology to conserve water and plastic film mulching application to improve yields of potatoes, vegetables, fruits and berries
actions.description: Increased agriculture products
actions.outcome: Increased agriculture products
actions.indicator: Increased cropland where new technologies are introduced
actions.implementationStatus: Crop farmers as well as family farmers are already familiar with using drip irrigation technology and increasing its use, but it will take still quite time to be applied in a wide range of farms. Plastic film mulching application started and ongoing.
actions.objectives: Increased cropland where new technologies are introduced

actions.name: Establishment of forest wind break on cropland to reduce soil erosion due to the impacts of climate change and drought
actions.description: Improved cropland and soil fertility
actions.outcome: Improved cropland and soil fertility
actions.indicator: Length of forest wind break (thousand km)
actions.implementationStatus: This is just at the starting stage. This measure is integrated with 'Billion Tree' initiatives.
actions.objectives: Length of forest wind break (thousand km)

actions.name: Protection of headwaters of rivers, streams, springs, and mineral springs to ensure sustainable water resources and use
actions.description: Improved water resources and access
actions.outcome: Improved water resources and access
actions.indicator: Number of protected water sources
actions.implementationStatus: The headwaters of 203 springs in 2021 and 325 springs in 2022 have been protected.
actions.objectives: Number of protected water sources

actions.name: Expansion of mid-scale hydrological mapping and determine the distribution of water resources
actions.description: Improved planning on surface water resources
actions.outcome: Improved planning on surface water resources
actions.indicator: Percentage of total mapped area
actions.implementationStatus: Mapping is not yet completed. By 2022 water resources study covered 107 sites and established 12,321.38 l/c water resources availability. The study was approved by the National Water Committee.
actions.objectives: Percentage of total mapped area

actions.name: Increase groundwater monitoring and analysis using existing and new borehole sites
actions.description: Increased knowledge of groundwater resources and impacts of climate change
actions.outcome: Increased knowledge of groundwater resources and impacts of climate change
actions.indicator: Number of groundwater monitoring and analysis borehole sites
actions.implementationStatus: This is ongoing work but not yet assessed quantitatively.
actions.objectives: Number of groundwater monitoring and analysis borehole sites

actions.name: Establishment of rain water harvesting ponds leveraging the natural landscapes in order to retain rainwater, snow and ice melt considering seasonal changes and intensity of precipitation
actions.description: Increased water resources and resilience to climate change
actions.outcome: Increased water resources and resilience to climate change
actions.indicator: Number of rain water harvesting ponds
actions.implementationStatus: Identification of sites where to build the rainwater harvesting pond is ongoing. The plan is to build at least one in each soum.
actions.objectives: Number of rain water harvesting ponds

actions.name: Organize training on climate change resilience and adaptation of forest ecosystem, accreditation of professional forestry organizations, adopt forest maintenance and cleaning technologies and processes, determining and assessing degrading forest
actions.description: Improved maintenance and protection of forest and forest ecosystems
actions.outcome: Improved maintenance and protection of forest and forest ecosystems
actions.indicator: Number of accredited professional forestry organizations
actions.implementationStatus: To implement the identified adaptation measures, Mongolia is implementing the Sustainable Resilient Ecosystem and Agriculture Management in Mongolia (STREAM+) Project.
actions.objectives: Number of accredited professional forestry organizations

actions.name: Rehabilitation of forest area through improvement of the incentive system to support a protection and sustainable use of forest
actions.description: Improved forest and forest ecosystems
actions.outcome: Improved forest and forest ecosystems
actions.indicator: Amount of rehabilitated forest area (ha)
actions.implementationStatus: The project forms part of the European Forest Partnership. It provides support with the transition towards a green economy by promoting climate-responsive and future-proof use of agriculture, forestry and the environment, using both political and practical means.
actions.objectives: Amount of rehabilitated forest area (ha)

actions.name: Maintenance and improvement of the saxaul forest ecosystem through development of agro-forest industry
actions.description: Improved saxaul forest
actions.outcome: Improved saxaul forest
actions.indicator: Improved and reforested area of depleted saxaul forest
actions.implementationStatus: It promotes biodiversity, environmentally friendly forestry and the resilience of the population.
actions.objectives: Improved and reforested area of depleted saxaul forest

actions.name: Determination and protection of climate change sensitive ecosystems, biodiversity through planting of endangered and vulnerable flora and fauna
actions.description: Improved protection of sensitive ecosystems, biodiversity
actions.outcome: Improved protection of sensitive ecosystems, biodiversity
actions.indicator: Planted list of endangered and vulnerable flora and fauna
actions.implementationStatus: As per Environmental outlook of MECC, there are 9 Critically Endangered, 13 Endangered, 83 Vulnerable, and 97 Near Threatened species of plants accounted in 2022. There are 20 nurseries nursing more than 10 endangered and vulnerable species at 2315 ha area in 7 aimags of Mongolia.
actions.objectives: Planted list of endangered and vulnerable flora and fauna

actions.name: Conduct a resource assessment on plant distribution by the plant geographical range
actions.description: Improved planning and protection of biodiversity
actions.outcome: Improved planning and protection of biodiversity
actions.indicator: Number of study reports with improved information on plants
actions.implementationStatus: The Institute of Botany is conducting various studies in different places.
actions.objectives: Number of study reports with improved information on plants

actions.name: Conduct a resource assessment on fauna distribution by monitoring in stages
actions.description: Improved planning and protection of sensitive fauna
actions.outcome: Improved planning and protection of sensitive fauna
actions.indicator: Animal species, their distribution and resource research-monitoring work
actions.implementationStatus: The aimag Departments of Environment are conducting inventory of wildlife.
actions.objectives: Animal species, their distribution and resource research-monitoring work

actions.name: Re-develop and approve ecological-economic assessment methodology on flora
actions.description: Improved ecological-economic assessment on flora
actions.outcome: Improved ecological-economic assessment on flora
actions.indicator: Approved ecological-economic assessment methodology on flora
actions.implementationStatus: Methodology developed and approved on 22 December 2022 by order No. A/603 of the Environment and Tourism Minister.
actions.objectives: Approved ecological-economic assessment methodology on flora

actions.name: Conduct disaster prevention training for local herders, community groups, and environment protection cooperatives
actions.description: Improved knowledge of local people on disaster prevention
actions.outcome: Improved knowledge of local people on disaster prevention
actions.indicator: Number of community groups and cooperatives trained
actions.implementationStatus: NEMA conducts regular training at national as well as at local level. Disaster preparedness campaigns have reached over 771,600 participants, including herders and vulnerable rural populations, equipping them with practical knowledge and resources to mitigate disaster impacts.
actions.objectives: Number of community groups and cooperatives trained
actions.implementingEntity: NEMA, MET, MOFALI, Emergency management departments of capital city and local administration
responsibleOrgs: Emergency management departments of capital city and local administration

actions.name: Develop and adopt early warning system for various climatic, meteorological disasters and catastrophic events
actions.description: Improved protection plan
actions.outcome: Improved protection plan
actions.indicator: Number of established early warning systems
actions.implementationStatus: NAMEM with collaboration of NEMA established a centralized disaster risk information system which strengthened decision-making processes, allowing real-time data dissemination to communities and authorities.
actions.objectives: Number of established early warning systems

actions.name: Conduct training on reduction of climate-related risks and their impact on response actions
actions.description: Improved knowledge of local people on climate impacts
actions.outcome: Improved knowledge of local people on climate impacts
actions.indicator: Number of persons trained
actions.implementationStatus: Health risk assessments have prioritized critical areas such as zoonotic disease prevalence, water quality, and heat stress impacts. Public awareness campaigns, supported by institutional training programs, have enhanced resilience among health professionals and local communities.
actions.objectives: Number of persons trained
actions.implementingEntity: MON, Aimag public health departments, Governor's secretariat of capital city and aimags
responsibleOrgs: Governor's secretariat of capital city and aimags

actions.name: Increase number of medical researchers, academia and healthcare workers trained on methodology of climate change related research
actions.description: Improved capacity of climate assessment on health care
actions.outcome: Improved capacity of climate assessment on health care
actions.indicator: Number of personnel trained
actions.implementationStatus: Conducted tailored training for healthcare workers in rural areas has improved early detection and response to climate-induced health risks, including outbreaks of vector-borne diseases.
actions.objectives: Number of personnel trained

actions.name: Conduct research and assessment on impact of climate change on human health and wellbeing
actions.description: Improved information and research on climate change impacts on health
actions.outcome: Improved information and research on climate change impacts on health
actions.indicator: Research and evaluation
actions.implementationStatus: These measures are vital for reducing the health burden of climate change and safeguarding vulnerable populations.
actions.objectives: Research and evaluation

actions.name: Conduct impact assessment of climate change on food nutrition and food safety
actions.description: Improved information and research on climate change impacts on food nutrition and food safety
actions.outcome: Improved information and research on climate change impacts on food nutrition and food safety
actions.indicator: Number of research studies conducted
actions.implementationStatus: Just started.
actions.objectives: Number of research studies conducted

actions.name: Develop public awareness campaign plan for reducing climate change and environment pollution
actions.description: Improved knowledge of public
actions.outcome: Improved knowledge of public
actions.indicator: Approved public awareness campaign plan
actions.implementationStatus: Plan is under preparation.
actions.objectives: Approved public awareness campaign plan

actions.name: Establish Youth network on 'Climate change and air'
actions.description: Improved information exchange and involvement of youth in climate change
actions.outcome: Improved information exchange and involvement of youth in climate change
actions.indicator: Number of functional youth networks on climate change and air pollution
actions.implementationStatus: MET is working actively to engage youth in climate change and has conducted the 'Climate Change and Youth' international forum in Ulaanbaatar on August 23-24 in collaboration with specialized agencies of the United Nations, Mongolian Children's Council, Mongolian Red Cross Society, Oyu Tolgoi LLC, Mongolian Sustainable Development Bridge, Caritas Czech Republic in Mongolia, World Vision, and People in Need NGO at the initiative of the President of Mongolia. UNICEF and the Scout Association of Mongolia launched the Youth for Climate and Clean Air Network (YOUCCAN).
actions.objectives: Number of functional youth networks on climate change and air pollution
actions.implementingEntity: MET, Department of family, children and youth, National Committee for children, Mongolian Scout association
responsibleOrgs: Department of family, children and youth
